conversation_settings_acceptance_check.name: conversation_settings_acceptance_check
conversation_settings_acceptance_check.value: "conversation_settings"."enabled" = 0 OR ("conversation_settings"."disclosure_version" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_settings"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

publications_failure_stage_check.name: publications_failure_stage_check
publications_failure_stage_check.value: ("publications"."status" = 'failed') = ("publications"."failure_stage" IS NOT NULL) AND ("publications"."failure_stage" IS NULL OR "publications"."failure_stage" IN ('validation', 'commit', 'push'))

publications_commit_check.name: publications_commit_check
publications_commit_check.value: "publications"."status" NOT IN ('committed', 'push_requested', 'pushing', 'pushed') OR "publications"."commit_sha" IS NOT NULL

security_settings_acceptance_check.name: security_settings_acceptance_check
security_settings_acceptance_check.value: "security_settings"."trusted_local_enabled" = 0 OR ("security_settings"."trusted_local_disclosure_version" IS NOT NULL AND "security_settings"."trusted_local_accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "security_settings"."trusted_local_accepted_risks_json" IS NOT NULL)

task_proposals_approved_check.name: task_proposals_approved_check
task_proposals_approved_check.value: ("task_proposals"."status" = 'approved') = ("task_proposals"."task_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("task_proposals"."status" = 'approved') = ("task_proposals"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)
